messages:
maria: Heads-up — running a set of short hands-on labs next week focused on migration + inference tuning for three mid-market customers flagged with renewal risk. Need SE volunteers to co-run + one CS pairing for post-session adoption checks. Proposed slots: Tue 11:00 PT, Wed 14:00 PT, Thu 09:30 PT, Thu 16:00 PT.

kevin: I can take Tue 11:00 PT. happy to cover demo and quick perf checklist. :thumbsup:

anna: Wed 14:00 PT works for me. can we keep agenda to 40m demo + 20m Q&A so we stay tight?

maria: Agree on 40/20. Draft agenda: 1) 5m intros & outcomes 2) 10m infra checklist (vpc, keys, network) 3) 15m migration walkthrough (model pinning, quant profiles) 4) 10m runbook + rollbacks 5) 20m live Q&A + notes.

sam: I can do Thu 09:30 PT and volunteer to run the post-session feedback poll + follow-up action list. I'll prep a short Supersets of questions (ease, blockers, next steps).

olivia: Thu 16:00 PT is fine but need someone to pair on the debugging demo — I have calendar conflict late Wed. Anyone swap?

anna: I can swap from Wed -> Thu 16:00 PT if that helps. then Anna -> Thu 16 and Sam -> Thu 09:30?

kevin: OK with that swap. final assignments?

maria: Current assignments: Tue 11:00 PT = Kevin (SE) + Maria (CS); Wed slot dropped; Thu 09:30 PT = Sam (SE + feedback owner); Thu 16:00 PT = Anna (SE) + Olivia (CS). I'll update invites: recording, shared notes link, and a short pre-read.

kevin: Pre-read suggestion: 1-pager on recommended quantization profiles + sample batch config. I can draft and drop in the invite.

sam: I'll create the feedback form (Google form) and set auto-reminder 24h after session. Will share link in the notes.

zara-bot: calendar: invite created for 2024-05-14T11:00:00-07:00 (Tue) and 2024-05-16T09:30:00-07:00 and 2024-05-16T16:00:00-07:00.

olivia: tiny ask — can we include a 5-min checklist card for customers to run before the session (sample input, token budget, model name)? that'll cut setup time.

maria: Yes — I'll add a checklist block in the invite and paste a small pre-check snippet:

```
# pre-check
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/checks -d '{"model":"rwkv-22", "sample_input":"hi"}'
```

kevin: Perfect. Also adding a short slide on rollback patterns.

maria: Great. Last bit — capture customer sentiment during the session and flag any "renewal risk" items in the shared notes (tag with #renewal-risk). Sam will send the feedback form 24h after.

anna: noted. will help triage notes during the Q&A.

maria: Thanks everyone — I'll send updated calendar invites and a follow-up checklist this afternoon. :rocket:
